```{r}
# Define UI for app that draws a histogram ----
ui <- page_sidebar(
  # App title ----
  title = "Hello World!",
  # Sidebar panel for inputs ----
  sidebar = sidebar(
    # Input: Slider for the number of bins ----
    sliderInput(
      inputId = "bins",
      label = "Number of bins:",
      min = 1,
      max = 50,
      value = 30
    )
  ),
  # Output: Histogram ----
  plotOutput(outputId = "distPlot")
)

# Define server logic required to draw a histogram ----
server <- function(input, output) {
  
  output$distPlot <- renderPlot({
    
    x    <- faithful$waiting
    bins <- seq(min(x), max(x), length.out = input$bins + 1)
    
    hist(x, breaks = bins, col = "#007bc2", border = "white",
         xlab = "Waiting time to next eruption (in mins)",
         main = "Histogram of waiting times")
    
  })
  
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
print("testing")
```
```{r}
#Sections for reviews within data frame

columns = ["place", "overall", "wifi", "outlets", "busyness", "noise", "seating"]
df = x.DataFrame(columns=columns)

# Add a review (e.g., when the user submits their ratings)
def add_review(df, place, overall, wifi, outlets, busyness, noise, seating):
    ratings = [overall, wifi, outlets, busyness, noise, seating]
    if not all(1 <= r <= 5 for r in ratings):
        raise ValueError("Ratings must be between 1 and 5")
    df.loc[len(df)] = [place, *ratings]
    return df

df = add_review(df, "Blue Bottle", 5, 4, 3, 2, 4, 3)
df = add_review(df, "Blue Bottle", 4, 5, 2, 3, 3, 4)

# Average each category per place
print(df.groupby("place")[columns[1:]].mean())
```
